facts.text: Trebol implements TSP hello detection: `helloQuery` sends a `hello` query followed by DA1, and `detectTern` accepts capabilities only when a v1 hello reply precedes the DA1 answer, otherwise returning null.
`.pi/lib/tern/run.ts` is an opt-in runner that execs the native `pi` CLI unchanged when no TSP hello reply arrives, and only otherwise creates a Pi runtime driven through `PiTernBridge`.

The Luau halves of the Code Puppy Tern launcher plugin are `tern-plugins/code-puppy/host.luau` (status block) and `tern-plugins/code-puppy/window.luau` (palette commands Start, Status, Interrupt, Stop).

Trebol's Tern surface class `TernInlineSurface` opens in `inline` mode, while the Code Puppy `python-plugin` draws final responses as a read-only `flow` surface; neither is a full-screen `screen` surface.
The Code Puppy plugin README states there is no agent transcript API for Code Puppy: `cx.agents:transcript` is omp-only, so Trebol cannot assume a structured transcript from it for Pi or Code Puppy.
evidence: tern-plugins/code-puppy/README.md#Coverage vs. the Code Puppy TSP integration (1:1 is NOT possible here)

facts.text: Trebol's Pi Tern composer in `.pi/lib/tern/composer-view.ts` targets OMP's Tern composer node for node, fed only by Pi data; elements Pi has no source for are omitted rather than faked.

The Code Puppy Tern integration is a two-plugin design (Luau launcher plus Python `python-plugin`), not a direct integration; the earlier direct TSP edits are preserved in a snapshot and no longer imported.

The Code Puppy Tern Python plugin uses Code Puppy's own plugin mechanism: it imports `register_callback` from `code_puppy.callbacks` and is meant to be installed by linking `python-plugin` into `~/.code_puppy/plugins/tern`.
The working Code Puppy checkout adds only a generic `render_final_response` hook in core; all Tern-specific output lives in `tern-plugins/code-puppy/python-plugin/`.
The Code Puppy Tern plugin falls back to Rich output for anything other than a final `agent_response` banner, on no TSP, oversize frames, or write errors, and nothing is installed automatically.
